newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX AMSTERDAM V AUXERRE TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX AMSTERDAM V AUXERRE TEAMS.

Auxerre - 1-Lionel Charbonnier, 12-Taribo West, 13-Frederic Danjou, 4-Franck Silvestre, 22-Eric Assati, 14-Christian Henna, 6-Philippe Violeau, 8-Moussa Saib, 17-Steve Marlet, 9-Lilian Laslandes, 11-Bernard Diomede.
